metadata.description: Maintenance-mode Claude Code marketplace; selected tools are moving to epologee/laicluse-agent-fieldkit

plugins.name: clipboard
plugins.description: DEPRECATED. clipboard has moved to clipboard@laicluse-agent-fieldkit; the commands are unchanged (/clipboard, /clipboard slack). Install the successor, then run `claude plugins uninstall clipboard@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart deprecation notice; no skills remain.

plugins.name: bonsai
plugins.description: DEPRECATED. bonsai has moved to bonsai@laicluse-agent-fieldkit, now a cross-platform CLI (create, setup, prune) with no clipboard and no macOS requirement. Install the successor, then run `claude plugins uninstall bonsai@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart deprecation notice; no skills remain.

plugins.name: dont-do-that

Install dont-do-that@laicluse-agent-fieldkit, then run `claude plugins uninstall dont-do-that@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart deprecation notice; no skills, guards, or hooks remain.

plugins.name: drydry

plugins.name: export-skill
plugins.description: Export a skill for sharing. Orchestrator plus five user-invocable sub-skills: sanitize (PII + security), translate (en/nl), port (linux/windows/macos), package (zip or md), share (clipboard + Finder handoff).

Install the successor, then run `claude plugins uninstall eye-of-the-beholder@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart deprecation notice; no skills remain.

plugins.name: ground

plugins.name: recap
plugins.description: Structured status overview of the current session: what we are doing, where we are, what is next. Useful when returning to a session after idle time, after compaction, or after a long stretch of repetitive background output.

plugins.name: recursion
plugins.description: Nightly workflow-improvement loop. /recursion orchestrates schedule, state, focus, and reject. Ships with an internal research sub-skill that runs the deep research workflow producing atomic improvement plans.

plugins.name: rename-suggestion
plugins.description: END OF LIFE. rename-suggestion is discontinued with no successor; it will not move to laicluse-agent-fieldkit. Run `claude plugins uninstall rename-suggestion@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart notice; no skills remain. The idea needs no plugin: ask your agent for a short descriptive session name ending in a /rename line.

plugins.name: saysay

plugins.name: screen-recording
plugins.description: Automated screen recordings and demo videos of browser-based features using Playwright video recording.

plugins.name: autonomous
plugins.description: DEPRECATED. autonomous has split into rover@laicluse-agent-fieldkit (the mission framework; /autonomous:rover is now /rover:rover, same rename for prepare, decide, pride, trim, verify, stop, rover-help) and autonomous@laicluse-agent-fieldkit (only the keepalive/cron/wake layer, pulled in by the rover itself). Install both successors, then run `claude plugins uninstall autonomous@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart deprecation notice; no skills remain. Existing .autonomous/ loop files stay readable by the successor rover.

plugins.name: gitgit
plugins.description: DEPRECATED. gitgit has moved to git-discipline@laicluse-agent-fieldkit. Install git-discipline@laicluse-agent-fieldkit, then run `claude plugins uninstall gitgit@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart deprecation notice; no skills, guards, or commit hooks remain, so it no longer enforces commit discipline.

plugins.name: leclause
plugins.description: Marketplace-wide utilities and migration notices for the leclause-skills marketplace. Currently ships /leclause:whats-new, a one-stop reader for the post-update CHANGELOG section of any installed leclause plugin.

plugins.name: anger-management
plugins.description: DEPRECATED. anger-management has moved to anger-management@laicluse-agent-fieldkit. Install anger-management@laicluse-agent-fieldkit, then run `claude plugins uninstall anger-management@leclause`. This plugin now ships only a SessionStart deprecation notice; no skills remain. Existing friction captures migrate to the new storage root automatically.
